error[L0315]: this argument is passed `inout`, so the call may change its storage while `held` still views it
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/field-lent-beside-what-its-binding-holds/program.ldn:37:10
   |
37 |     grow(s.list) else begin return end -- error: `s.view` may refer into it
   |          ^^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/field-lent-beside-what-its-binding-holds/program.ldn:36:5
   |
36 |     held := addr s.view
   |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ the live derived view
  = note: [0800]/[0830]: the `inout` parameter `l` locks its argument whether or not the routine writes it; finish with `held` before the call and take it again after, or, if the routine only reads it, declare `l` without `inout`; `held` reaches `s`, and what `s` holds may refer into `s.list`
